cues: Here is the law the whole unit rests on.
Substances always react in the ratio of their equivalents.
One gram equivalent of an acid exactly neutralises one gram equivalent of a base.
One equivalent of an oxidising agent exactly oxidises one equivalent of a reducing agent.
Whatever the mole ratio in the balanced equation.
